## RunEnv.limits property

concurrent loads per connector, each a whole number from 1 or `Infinity`<!-- -->; every loader on a  connector runs under its limit, and a connector without one is not bounded. Each run counts  its own loads. Default: no limit

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly limits?: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
```
